suggestion.problemOrOpportunity: The broken-windows gauge that CI prints reads 0 while target follow-ups remain open. Follow-ups live only as decision JSON with no closure state, and the gauge cannot see tools/, .github/ or configuration.
suggestion.scope: Widen tools/board-count.mjs to every tracked text file outside docs/, using comment syntax for YAML and MJS. Clarify in rule 21 that a follow-up which boards a target defect, or a temporary shim such as the tool-v0 reader, adds a marker at the defect's site. Record bytes stay unchanged.
suggestion.expectedValue: CI's board count becomes a true count of open target defects, and closure becomes observable as a marker's removal.
suggestion.uncertainty: Only 6 of the 77 follow-ups were spot-checked. Many are launchpad-side planning items that should not be boarded in target code, and the launchpad register may already serve the operator.
risks: Marker noise if planning items get boarded
alternatives: Generate an in-repo open-follow-up index from the launchpad register at filing
Treat the launchpad register as the board and narrow rule 21's wording
duplicationHints: launchpad follow-up register named in WO-015-D022
suggestion.urgencyRationale: This is the evidenced constraint: a settled rule's only gauge currently misleads, and each new boarded follow-up widens the gap.
